title: Vet
description: data of: vet.py SESSION --json. Every candidate difference.py left in a session, with the evidence for what it is and a verdict. Each piece of evidence says whether it was measured here or reported by a catalogue, or is not known because the check was not made. Also kept as vetted.json beside the candidates.

unexplained.description: Candidates no check explains: the ones worth a person's eyes.

halves.description: The score in each half of the night, subtracted separately.

asteroid.description: A known asteroid or comet there at mid-session (SkyBoT), with its distance in arcsec.

in_reference.description: Magnitude of light already at the place in the reference, or null if none to speak of.
